package ar.edu.utn.frc.tup.piv.evaluacionllm;

/** Fixture de duplicacion, mitad 2. Bloque identico al de CopiaUno. */
public class CopiaDos {

    public int aggregate(int clarity, int depth, int accuracy, int originality, int rigor) {
        int total = 0;
        if (clarity > 0 && clarity <= 100) {
            total += clarity * 2;
        }
        if (depth > 0 && depth <= 100) {
            total += depth * 3;
        }
        if (accuracy > 0 && accuracy <= 100) {
            total += accuracy * 5;
        }
        if (originality > 0 && originality <= 100) {
            total += originality * 4;
        }
        if (rigor > 0 && rigor <= 100) {
            total += rigor * 6;
        }
        if (total > 500) {
            total = 500;
        }
        return total;
    }
}
